description: This file contains unit tests for network interface iterators and adapters, testing IPv4 and IPv6 address iterators, adapter iterators, and adapter observers in the WPEFramework Core module.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for network adapters, providing access to adapter properties such as name, MAC address, status, and related addresses.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for IPv4 addresses associated with network adapters.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for IPv6 addresses associated with network adapters.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Class for observing adapter events, with implementation of notification interface.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element, returns true if successful.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the adapter.

methods.name: MACAddress
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the adapter in string form or fills a provided buffer.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Sets the operational state of the adapter.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of addresses or interfaces.

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Returns the current address the iterator points to.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the address iterator to initial state.
